art_direction_plans.name: pure_white_character_focus
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: pure white character key visual; remove complex scenery so identity, hairstyle, eyes, and outfit silhouette become the entire focus
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: seamless pure white background with only soft shadow and tiny character-color graphic accents; no real location
art_direction_plans.visual_device: large white field, character color, and a few black line accents create a clear thumbnail
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: close knee-up or three-quarter pose, character large in frame, natural stable posture
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: strap maxi dress, fitted waist, flowing full skirt, elegant lightweight summer style
art_direction_plans.material_language: clean flowing cloth, a few ribbons, tiny accessories, soft hair
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: white dominates; character colors are the only strong memory point
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: high-key soft light, face and eyes very clear, no gray or dirty whites

art_direction_plans.name: zero_gravity_fairy_room
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: zero-gravity fairy-tale room; the character floats inside a soft dream space with petals, ribbons, and small toys drifting around
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: pale fairy-tale room or cloud space, pillows, petals, ribbons, paper stars, and small toys floating lightly
art_direction_plans.visual_device: floating objects form a circular rhythm that returns the eye to face and eyes
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: character lightly floating, body naturally curled or side-lying in the air, hands simple
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: light fairy-tale floating outfit, airy fabric, ribbons, soft fantasy feeling
art_direction_plans.material_language: light gauze, ribbon, cloud shapes, petals, soft toys, tiny glow particles
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: pale dream background plus character palette; clear and airy, not cluttered or oversaturated
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: soft dream light, light silhouette, face remains clear

art_direction_plans.name: zero_gravity_fairy_garden
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: zero-gravity fairy garden; the character floats between petals and sunlight, light, dreamy, and collectible
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: pale garden, cloud shapes, petals, transparent bubbles, and small fairy-tale ornaments floating with plenty of open air
art_direction_plans.visual_device: petals and bubbles form an upward flow line that strengthens the floating feeling
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: character floating near center or slightly above center, knee-up to full-body range, limbs relaxed
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: light fairy-tale floating outfit, airy fabric, ribbons, soft fantasy feeling
art_direction_plans.material_language: light gauze, petals, transparent bubbles, ribbons, soft hair
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: flower colors are accents only; character palette must remain the memory point
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: bright natural soft light with a slight glowing edge in the air

art_direction_plans.name: overhead_deep_perspective_space
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: high-angle anime CG composition; room plan, floor shape, table edges, and window light pattern are the main thumbnail before the character
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: camera looks down from above or stair height; floor tiles, railing, tabletop lines, or furniture edges create clear depth; character stays medium-readable and offset from center
art_direction_plans.visual_device: strong foreground-middle-background separation; the eye follows floor perspective and light shapes before reaching the character
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: medium readable figure seen from above, head, face direction, and hair silhouette readable, relaxed posture
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: clean light-novel casual outfit, character palette stays recognizable
art_direction_plans.material_language: floor reflection, table plane, window frame, soft cloth, paper, glass highlight
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: large floor or wall color block dominates; character palette is a controlled focal accent
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: top or window light draws hard geometric cuts across floor and furniture, with soft bounce on the character

art_direction_plans.name: low_angle_foreground_depth
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: low-angle upward anime screenshot composition; camera looks slightly up from floor, table, stairs, or garden-path height while the character stays readable
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: camera near floor, tabletop, stair, chair, or garden path level, looking upward through a foreground edge; midground character remains medium-readable and off-center; background rises behind the character
art_direction_plans.visual_device: low foreground object, middle character, and rising window, door, wall, tree, or ceiling line form a readable upward three-depth stack
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: medium readable figure seen from a low upward perspective, front three-quarter or clean side angle preferred, simple hands
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: fresh picnic outfit, short jacket or light cardigan, clear layered pieces
art_direction_plans.material_language: large blurred foreground edge, polished floor or stone path, glass, curtain, plant leaves, fabric
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: foreground shadow mass plus bright background plane; character color sits between them as the second read
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: low camera catches floor reflection and rim light; strong light direction clarifies depth

art_direction_plans.name: far_shot_readable_room
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: wide light-novel CG; environment carries emotion while the character remains the readable subject inside a room or terrace
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: longer camera distance with wide room, balcony, exhibit aisle, archive-like shelving, or clean interior floor visible; character occupies a medium-readable area near a third or corner
art_direction_plans.visual_device: large empty wall, floor, or window area and repeated perspective lines create scale; readable character placement creates quiet warmth or loneliness
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: readable full-body, knee-up, or three-quarter figure; identity kept by face, hair shape, color, and accessory silhouette
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: tank top, oversized cropped hoodie, loose jeans, relaxed casual style
art_direction_plans.material_language: wall, floor, window, shelf, railing, curtain, table plane, hoodie cotton, loose denim, soft reflection
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: dominant environment colors with one character-color accent; avoid filling the frame with the body
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: large soft light field, long shadow, or window beam gives spatial scale

art_direction_plans.name: telephoto_layered_interior
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: compressed telephoto interior or garden view; multiple vertical layers make the image feel found inside the scene
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: camera looks through shelves, curtains, plants, doorframes, or glass; foreground and background stack tightly while character remains off-center
art_direction_plans.visual_device: repeating frames and soft occlusion create depth; character appears between layers, not flat in front
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: front three-quarter or relaxed side view, partial crop allowed, face and identity hair/accessory cues remain visible
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: soft casual outfit with warm simple styling
art_direction_plans.material_language: glass reflection, curtain layers, shelf edges, leaves, ceramic, paper, soft cloth
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: stacked muted color planes; one sharper character-color accent controls the focal point
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: compressed light bands, reflected highlights, and soft shadow layers separate foreground, character, and background

art_direction_plans.name: hosiery_tea_room
art_direction_plans.graphic_concept: rare refined tea-room fashion illustration; black hosiery appears only as a restrained styling element, not the main theme
art_direction_plans.spatial_structure: small tea table, chair, pale curtain, and flower vase; simple soft room with no leg-focused framing
art_direction_plans.visual_device: controlled clothing contrast supports character colors without dominating the thumbnail
art_direction_plans.body_silhouette: seated or side-standing pose, natural leg posture, hands simple and clear; no fetish framing
art_direction_plans.outfit_direction: rare refined black hosiery fashion outfit, restrained and non-fetishized
art_direction_plans.material_language: thin black stockings, skirt hem, blouse, ribbon, soft cloth
art_direction_plans.color_strategy: outfit contrast stays secondary; background uses soft interior tones, character colors remain primary
art_direction_plans.lighting_behavior: soft indoor natural light, no harsh shadow or dramatic leg emphasis
